gloss: to cut corners, to slack off

definitions.gloss: to cut corners, to slack off, to do sloppy work
definitions.explanation: To not put in proper effort, doing something carelessly or incompletely to save time or effort.

examples.japanese: {手|て}を{抜|ぬ}いた⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すぐに→すぐに：02905_suguni⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: You can tell right away when work has been done sloppily.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦からといって→からといって：noentry⟧{手|て}を{抜|ぬ}いて⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いけない→いけない：02335_ikenai⟧。
examples.english: You shouldn't cut corners just because you're busy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{絶対|ぜったい}→絶対：00435_zettai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手|て}を{抜|ぬ}かない。
examples.english: I never cut corners when cooking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{手|て}を{抜|ぬ}いた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦バレた→ばれる：06721_bareru⟧。
examples.english: They found out I did a sloppy job cleaning.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何十年|なんじゅうねん}→何十年：noentry⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{手|て}を{抜|ぬ}かずに⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}けてきた→続ける：01231_tsuzukeru⟧。⟦だからこそ→だからこそ：27569_dakarakoso⟧⟦{信頼|しんらい}されている→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧。
examples.english: That craftsman has continued working without cutting corners for decades. That's why he's trusted.

notes:
STRUCTURE: ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand) + ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ + {抜|ぬ}く (to pull out/remove). The image is of removing one's hand from the work.

NUANCE: Generally negative - implies negligence or laziness. However, can occasionally be neutral when discussing efficiency or knowing where to save effort appropriately.

NEGATIVE FORM: {手|て}を{抜|ぬ}かない (to not cut corners) - often used positively
- 「{手|て}を{抜|ぬ}かない⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧」(a craftsman who never cuts corners)
